label: Doc maintenance (coding agent, 30 min)
description: Per-workspace doc upkeep: respect existing layout (default) or optional bootstrap. Uses docs/DOC_PROFILE.md as project memory and docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md per run. Pick workspace in dropdown; enable job after selection.

job.title: Doc maintenance
job.instructions: See coding_workflow.doc_maintenance_mode — instructions are generated server-side (respect | bootstrap).

coding_workflow.prompt_preamble: Conservative scheduled doc maintenance. Prefer small, accurate doc edits. Stop early if git pull fails or tree is dirty.
